title: MOURINHO CLAIMS RODRI HESITATED, SO MADRID WALKED AWAY
description:
A header at Real Betis, 51 days after his debut. Slow start, good finish?

Rodri joined Barcelona this summer, and the soap opera started straight away. Mourinho says Rodri hesitated and Madrid dropped out. A midfielder who thinks first. Scandal.

His debut came off the bench: 'I am where I want to be.' Fifty-one days later, that header at Betis.

Then the awards season. Two years after his own Ballon d'Or, he finished fourth, behind Kane, Mbappé and Yamal. In ESPN's November top ten, Yamal, his new teammate, is first and Rodri isn't there at all.

Hesitation, or just a midfielder doing his thinking? Tell us which side you're on.
